name: bug-tracker-monorepo
description: BugTracker — Enterprise Issue & Project Tracking System

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.clean: rm -rf backend/dist frontend/dist coverage backend/coverage frontend/coverage backend/*.tsbuildinfo frontend/*.tsbuildinfo *.log npm-debug.log*
